subject: ISO/FedRAMP tactical handover & evidence sequencing for regional audits
messages:
From: Elaine Reid <elaine.reid@riverside-audit.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@rivermark-bank.com>
Date: 2025-09-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Intake: ISO scope confirmation + SIG/CAIQ collateral

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this on. As we prepare the regional FedRAMP readiness check and the parallel ISO 27001 intake, a couple of clarifications to make sure we scope evidence requests properly:

- Can you confirm the service boundary for Rivermark's integration (are we including only the hosted API or also Dedicated capacity used by their environment)?
- For SIG/CAIQ items that reference network segmentation and key management, do you have a single owner we should route sample requests to, or do we need separate contacts per domain?
- Preferred evidence windows: would next month (Oct 6-10) work for log snapshots and KV cache traces, or do you recommend a different period?

Attached: Riverside-intake-form.pdf (pdf)

If useful, we can do a 30-min call tomorrow. Thanks — elaine

--
Elaine Reid
Principal Auditor, Riverside Audit Partners
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Reid <elaine.reid@riverside-audit.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@rivermark-bank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-09-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: ISO scope confirmation + SIG/CAIQ collateral

Elaine,

Thanks — quick answers inline and a few asks so we can produce a clean MAP (mutual action plan):

- Service boundary: For Rivermark's evaluation we will include both Hosted API (production) and the Dedicated pool used by their integration. We will exclude internal experimental clusters. (owner: Karthik)
- Evidence owners: Karthik will be the primary owner for runtime/network evidence (logs, segmentation diagrams); Grace will own key management and encryption artifacts.
- Preferred window: Oct 6-10 is viable but we have higher traffic on Oct 7 due to a planned release. Could we propose Oct 8-10 for the heavier artifacts and Oct 6 for snapshotting? Please confirm.

Open asks for you:
- Any mandatory CSV format for the intake form? We can adapt but wanted to check.
- Will the auditor team accept our encrypted archive on S3 (presigned link) or do you need a transmittal via secure upload? We prefer S3 presigned links with KMS envelope encryption.

I attached a draft MAP and a link to the folder with control narratives.

Next steps: If you confirm windows we will schedule owners and produce the artifacts list with filename templates.

Best,
Monica

Attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MAP-draft

--
Monica Patel
Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Reid <elaine.reid@riverside-audit.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-09-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: ISO scope confirmation + SIG/CAIQ collateral

Monica / Elaine —

Confirmed: we will include Dedicated pool details and provide segmentation diagrams, KV cache traces for the Oct 8-10 window. I'll own the logs and runtime traces; Grace will export key rotation records and KMS configs.

One note: for the CAIQ sections referencing ephemeral key wrapping, we have an HSM-backed flow for production keys and a soft-KMS for dev. We'll separate those artifacts and label them by environment.

-Karthik
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Reid <elaine.reid@riverside-audit.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@rivermark-bank.com>
Date: 2025-09-21T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: ISO scope confirmation + SIG/CAIQ collateral

Thanks all — quick mutual action plan below (draft):

1) Oct 6: Snapshot exports (low-traffic): configuration manifests, access lists (owner: Karthik)
2) Oct 8-10: Live artifacts: log bundles (rolling 48h windows), KV/endpoint traces, segmentation packet captures (owner: Karthik)
3) Oct 8: Key material exports (rotation history, HSM attestation, KMS policies) (owner: Grace)
4) Oct 9: Control narratives and CAIQ draft responses (owner: Monica)

Delivery mechanism: S3 presigned links (encrypted via customer-managed KMS). Elaine — please confirm acceptance.

Action items assigned and I'll follow up with calendar invites and filename templates by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Monica
